decisionPolicy.familyMeans: A reusable location/cast/lighting language boundary, not automatic byte reuse.
decisionPolicy.variantRule: A materially different authored action or knowledge state receives its own portrait/landscape pair inside the family.
decisionPolicy.reuseRule: Only adjacent cues with the same physical action may share a pair; a shared room alone is not sufficient.
decisionPolicy.dualFormatRule: Every planned pair has an independently composed 1024x1536 portrait and 1672x941 landscape source.
decisionPolicy.unmappedSceneRule: Every authored scene has exactly one final family and one or more explicit variant briefs.
